Implementation Plan

Plan for the e2e smoke canary update

Planning ref: `226abffcd9c865d84c1e20fb3aa7ec8dcf517ba6` (branch `main`). The integration-branch mismatch line reads `unknown`, not `true`, so planning continues.

## Files likely to change
- `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`

## Acceptance

ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py
ACCEPTANCE: post-merge none: this is a data-only canary file update with no post-merge workflow tied to it

## Functions or modules to implement
None. The file's whole content becomes exactly these 27+19+23 bytes (`status: ok\nrun_id: 42692493731\nupdated-by: ai-pipeline\n`):
```text
status: ok
run_id: 42692493731
updated-by: ai-pipeline
```
The file currently holds `status: ok` and `decompose-run: 41445772297`. Both lines are replaced.

## Data structures affected
Only the plain-text canary file. It must end with one LF, have no CRLF, no BOM and no extra lines.

## API or interface changes
None.

## Decisions
### D1 — Overwrite the whole file
- Chosen: replace the file content with exactly the three lines from the issue, including the trailing newline.
- Alternatives considered: edit only the changed lines; also update `tests/e2e_smoke_canary_spec.txt`.
- Why: the issue asks for a full replacement and allows changes to this one file only. The spec file is a template that the Phase 4b run of `test-and-mark-stable.yml` fills in, so it is outside this issue's scope.

## Security considerations
No trust boundary, endpoint, secret or money surface is involved. The only abuse risk is extra content getting into the file, such as an `E2E_EDITOR_BAIT_` marker. The plan rules this out by requiring exact content.

## Risks and edge cases
- `tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py` skips unless the Phase 4b environment variables are set, so a normal pytest run cannot fail because of this change.
- Open PRs #8786, #8368 and #8304 also touch this file and may cause merge conflicts. Those are separate earlier smoke runs, not duplicates of this issue.
- A missing trailing newline or extra whitespace would break the byte-for-byte check.

## Testing considerations
- Run `cmp` on the file against the `printf` output given in the issue.
- Run `git diff --stat` and confirm only `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt` changed.
- Run `pytest tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py`, which is expected to skip outside Phase 4b.

Scope-mode: Hold Scope
Reuse-audit: extends tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt
Scope-mode justification: The issue fully specifies one change to one existing file and forbids touching anything else. Holding scope is the complete implementation, and it follows §6 Core Priorities (Security > Correctness & safety > Backward compatibility > Operational clarity > Performance > Speed).
